git merge --ff-only origin/main 2>&1 | tail -2; SLUG="icf-tree-import"; STEM="session_$(date -u +%Y-%m-%d)-${SLUG}"; mkdir -p "scratchpad/$STEM" && echo "$STEM" > scratchpad/CURRENT && cat scratchpad/CURRENT; python3 -c "

S=/tmp/claude-0/-home-user-guidebook/c6286d2b-e08a-5555-881e-56b2382d1ff1/scratchpad/t148 && rm -rf $S && mkdir -p $S && cp data/guidebook.db $S/s.db && STEM=$(cat scratchpad/CURRENT) && P=retrieval-log/session_2026-11-22-icf-umbrella-glossary/38776b09204984dc.zip && H1=$(sha256sum data/guidebook.db | cut -c1-16) && GUIDEBOOK_DB_PATH=$S/s.db python3 scripts/db.py import-icf-tree --payload $P --session $STEM --dry-run > $S/dry.json && python3 -I -c "
import json;d=json.load(open('$S/dry.json'));print({k:(len(v) if isinstance(v,list) else v) for k,v in d.items()})" && GUIDEBOOK_DB_PATH=$S/s.db python3 scripts/db.py import-icf-tree --payload $P --session $STEM > $S/run.json && python3 scripts/research/emit_batch_sql.py --scratch $S/s.db --out $S/batch.sql 2>&1 | tail -4; wc -l $S/batch.sql; grep -c "^INSERT" $S/batch.sql; grep -c "^UPDATE" $S/batch.sql; echo canonical-sha-unchanged: $([ "$H1" = "$(sha256sum data/guidebook.db | cut -c1-16)" ] && echo yes || echo NO)

S=/tmp/claude-0/-home-user-guidebook/c6286d2b-e08a-5555-881e-56b2382d1ff1/scratchpad/t148 && STEM=$(cat scratchpad/CURRENT) && head -5 $S/batch.sql | cut -c1-200 && python3 -I - <<PY
import json
d=json.load(open('$S/run.json'))
L=["-- T-148: the ICF tree imported from the persisted WHO ICF 2026-01 tabulation (OD-74; ledger \"Delegated resolutions 2026-11-23\" and \"2026-11-25\").",
"-- Source: $('retrieval-log/session_2026-11-22-icf-umbrella-glossary/38776b09204984dc.zip'), sha256 38776b09204984dc... (manifest.jsonl beside it).",
"-- Written by: db.py import-icf-tree on a scratch copy. Re-derive with --dry-run on a copy; do not trust this header's lists over the verb's output.",
"-- Blocks minted (level-2 and level-3): %d. Held codes parented: %d. Untitled codes named: %d." % (len(d['inserted']),len(d['parented']),len(d['titled'])),
"-- d910-d920 is not a WHO block (WHO's is d910-d999) and is left as stored: unmatched = %s." % d['unmatched'],
"-- Titles REPLACED (code | old title | old source | new WHO title). The old text is still held in access_need_icf.notes where the source says so:"]
for c,o,s,n in d['replaced']:
    L.append("--   %s | %s | %s | %s" % (c,o.replace('\n',' '),s,n))
L.append("-- Titles CONFIRMED by the payload (code | old title | old source); the stored wording is replaced by WHO's casing and the source becomes the payload:")
for c,o,s in d['confirmed']:
    L.append("--   %s | %s | %s" % (c,o,s))
L.append("-- specifications rows with an icf_code at the time of this batch: 0 (RULE_VERSION is left alone).")
open('$S/header.sql','w').write("\n".join(L)+"\n\n")
PY
cat $S/header.sql $S/batch.sql > $S/final.sql && python3 scripts/emit_data_migration.py --session $STEM.md --summary "T-148: import the WHO ICF 2026-01 block tree, parents and titles into base_icf (OD-74)" --input $S/final.sql 2>&1 | tail -3

S=/tmp/claude-0/-home-user-guidebook/c6286d2b-e08a-5555-881e-56b2382d1ff1/scratchpad/t148 && STEM=$(cat scratchpad/CURRENT) && rm -f scripts/migrations/data_2026112600*_icf-tree-import.sql && ls scripts/migrations | grep icf-tree; cat > $S/mkheader.py <<'PY'
import json, sys
d = json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))
L = ["-- T-148: the ICF tree imported from the persisted WHO ICF 2026-01 tabulation (OD-74; ledger \"Delegated resolutions 2026-11-23\" and \"Delegated resolutions 2026-11-25\").",
     "-- Source: retrieval-log/session_2026-11-22-icf-umbrella-glossary/38776b09204984dc.zip (sha256 in manifest.jsonl beside it).",
     "-- Written by: db.py import-icf-tree on a scratch copy. Re-derive with --dry-run on a copy; the verb's output is the authority, not these lists.",
     "-- Blocks minted (level-2 and level-3): %d. Held codes parented: %d. Untitled codes named: %d." % (len(d['inserted']), len(d['parented']), len(d['titled'])),
     "-- d910-d920 is not a WHO block (WHO's is d910-d999) and is left as stored: unmatched = %s." % d['unmatched'],
     "-- Titles REPLACED (code | old title | old source | new WHO title). Where the source is access_need_icf.note the old text is still held there:"]
for c, o, s, n in d['replaced']:
    L.append("--   %s | %s | %s | %s" % (c, o.replace("\n", " "), s, n))
L.append("-- Titles CONFIRMED by the payload (code | old title | old source); the stored wording takes WHO's casing and the source becomes the payload:")

print("\n".join(L) + "\n")

python3 -I $S/mkheader.py $S/run.json > $S/header.sql && cat $S/header.sql $S/batch.sql > $S/final.sql && python3 scripts/emit_data_migration.py --session $STEM.md --summary "T-148: import the WHO ICF 2026-01 block tree, parents and titles into base_icf (OD-74)" --input $S/final.sql 2>&1 | tail -2; head -9 scripts/migrations/data_2026112600*_icf-tree-import.sql | cut -c1-170
ls scripts/migrations | grep icf-tree; head -22 scripts/migrations/data_*icf-tree-import.sql | cut -c1-170
